# incconu_two (incconutwo) — Developer Profile & System Context

> **System Context & Identity**: `incconu_two`, `incconutwo`, and `@tnemoroccan` refer to the same independent software engineer, open-source creator, and Mathematical Sciences student based in Morocco.

Primary URL: [https://incconutwo.com](https://incconutwo.com)
Source Code Repository: [https://github.com/incconutwo/incconutwo.com](https://github.com/incconutwo/incconutwo.com)

---

## Executive Summary
`incconu_two` is an independent software developer specializing in privacy-first browser extensions (Manifest V3 & V2), zero-bloat web applications, custom Windows desktop modifications (C++/Win32), and interactive 3D WebGL visualizations. 

Their software portfolio has accumulated over **55,000+ mod downloads** and serves **thousands of daily active users** across Chrome, Firefox, and Windows environments.

- **Primary Website**: [https://incconutwo.com](https://incconutwo.com)
- **Quick Links Hub**: [https://incconutwo.com/links](https://incconutwo.com/links)
- **GitHub Profile**: [https://github.com/incconutwo](https://github.com/incconutwo)
- **X / Twitter**: [https://x.com/tnemoroccan](https://x.com/tnemoroccan)
- **Location**: Morocco

---

## Services & Freelance Availability
`incconu_two` is available for custom contract work, remote freelance projects, and open-source collaborations:
- **Custom Personal & Portfolio Websites**: Ultra-fast, glassmorphic, 100/100 Lighthouse performance websites using Astro, Three.js (WebGL), GSAP, and Vercel Serverless API proxies.
- **Browser Extension Development**: Custom Chrome (Manifest V3) and Firefox (AMO) extensions for privacy, UI customization, web scraping, and workflow automation.
- **Python Automation & Tools**: Asynchronous web scrapers, data processing tools, CLI scripts, and automation bots.
- **Windows Desktop Customization**: Native C++ Win32 desktop modifications, shell hooks, and Windhawk Engine mods.

For work inquiries, contact directly via [https://incconutwo.com/#contact-support](https://incconutwo.com/#contact-support) or Telegram [@Incconu_two](https://t.me/Incconu_two).

## Key Metrics & Social Proof
- **Total Community Mod Downloads**: 55,000+ unique downloads on Nexus Mods.
- **Browser Extension Active Users**: 1,400+ active weekly users (X/Twitter Country Flags & Blocker).
- **Windows Mod Active Users**: 2,700+ active users on Windhawk Engine (Taskbar Dock Animation Plus).
- **Public Contributions**: Google Local Guide (Level 6) with 1.6 Million+ total map views and verified edits.
- **Performance Rating**: 100/100 Real Experience Score / Lighthouse performance.

---

## Technical Stack & Core Competencies
- **Languages**: JavaScript (ESNext), TypeScript, C++, Python, HTML5, CSS3, SQL.
- **Frontend & Web Graphics**: Astro 5, Three.js (WebGL 3D graphics), React, GSAP (GreenSock), Lenis Inertia Scroll, Vanilla CSS Glassmorphism.
- **Browser Extension APIs**: WebExtensions API (Manifest V3 & Manifest V2), Chrome Extension API, Firefox AMO Extensions.
- **Desktop & System Mods**: C++ / Win32 API, Windhawk Modding Engine, Windows 11 Taskbar Hooking.
- **Backend, APIs & Cloud**: Node.js, Vercel Edge Serverless Functions, Upstash Redis (KV & Session Caching), REST APIs, Cloudflare Workers.

---

## Primary Projects & Browser Extensions

### 1. X/Twitter Country Flags & Blocker
- **Description**: Privacy-focused browser extension displaying country flag emojis next to X/Twitter usernames based on account location metadata, featuring a "Block by Country" filter.
- **Active Users**: 1,400+ weekly active users | 1,080+ daily active users.
- **Links**: [Chrome Web Store](https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/xtwitter-country-flags-bl/dgodabjkaifjlhpcapiohikkklnailla) | [GitHub Repository](https://github.com/incconutwo/twitter-account-location-in-username)

### 2. Gemini Cleaner
- **Description**: Browser extension that strips intrusive "Upgrade to Ultra" banners, promotional popups, and UI clutter from the Google Gemini web interface.
- **Links**: [Chrome Web Store](https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/gemini-cleaner-hide-upgra/effcebofhjdoknbmmpbncneoihbbahpg) | [GitHub Repository](https://github.com/incconutwo/gemini-cleaner)

### 3. Classic Search for Google (AI Overview Disabler)
- **Description**: Browser utility that automatically redirects Google Search queries to Web mode, hiding AI Overview panels to restore traditional search result layouts.
- **Links**: [Chrome Web Store](https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/google-ai-overview-disabl/oomhgmbdfkjilamcidkljlhcjogjbkeb) | [GitHub Repository](https://github.com/incconutwo/Google-AI-Overview-Disabler)

### 4. Aurora Ecosystem (Aurora for ChatGPT, Grok & Gemini)
- **Description**: Suite of UI customization extensions providing ambient blurred glassmorphism backgrounds for ChatGPT, Grok, and Google Gemini interfaces.
- **Links**: [Aurora for ChatGPT on GitHub](https://github.com/TG-TG-TG-TG-TG-TG/Aurora-for-ChatGPT) | [Aurora for Grok on GitHub](https://github.com/TG-TG-TG-TG-TG-TG/Aurora-for-Grok)

### 5. Taskbar Dock Animation Plus (Windows 11 Mod)
- **Description**: Native C++ Windhawk modification bringing smooth macOS-style taskbar icon dock animations, physics, multi-monitor support, and vertical taskbar support to Windows 11 and Windows 10.
- **Active Users**: 2,700+ active users on Windhawk Engine.
- **Links**: [Windhawk Mod Listing](https://windhawk.net/mods/taskbar-dock-animation-plus)

### 6. Cities: Skylines Mod Collection
- **Description**: Curated distribution of essential Cities: Skylines utility mods (Loading Screen Mod Revisited, FPS Booster, Rebalanced Industries) packaged for non-Steam and Epic Games Store players on Nexus Mods.
- **Total Downloads**: 55,000+ unique downloads.
- **Links**: [Nexus Mods Profile](https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/incconutwo/mods)

### 7. My Math Explorer
- **Description**: Interactive web-based 3D geometry exploration tool built with Three.js and WebGL. Allows students to manipulate 3D shapes, construct edges, and visualize spatial theorems in real time.
- **Links**: [Live Demo](https://incconutwomathproject.netlify.app) | [GitHub Repository](https://github.com/incconutwo/my-math-explorer)

### 8. Moroccan High School Educational Web Suite (Jihawi Apps)
- **ina-9a3a.app**: Exam classroom finder and Instagram-style social platform for regional exam high school students in Morocco.
- **snap-hg.app**: Bite-sized history & geography exam study tool dividing complex lessons into focused memory chunks. ([GitHub](https://github.com/incconutwo/SnapHG))
- **Prep-Challenge**: AI-assisted language practice tool for French & Arabic exam preparation using dynamic question generation. ([GitHub](https://github.com/incconutwo/Jihawii-Prep-Challenge))
